metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from NextPhase Software: a live view of a project's delivery pipeline, a per-task token breakdown, and a switchboard to turn plugins on and off.

plugins.name: nextphase-task-tokens
plugins.description: Task tokens: a band and a pane showing the tokens the last task used, by kind, model, subagent and tool.

plugins.name: nextphase-pipeline-view
plugins.description: Pipeline view: a pane and status line showing where a project's current milestone stands, from a snapshot the project's own collector prints.

plugins.name: nextphase-switchboard
plugins.description: Switchboard: a pane listing every installed plugin and mod, with an on/off toggle for each that enables or disables it and reloads plugins in the open chat.
